title: Navidrome music-client functional inventory
scope: Navidrome source defines music-client functionality. MixRadio is a separate component/layout/visual/design reference. Native web administration APIs and Windows Phone UI are separate scopes.

expected: Proxy paths, credentials and opaque IDs retain their encoded values; requests use the actual client identity.
HTTP 200 failed Subsonic XML is rejected; a successfully authenticated secondary route can win.

steps: Save valid password credentials and both loopback/proxy routes.
Make the primary route return failed authentication; reconnect through the secondary.
Save invalid credentials, correct them, and reconnect.
expected: The authenticated route opens the real library.
Authentication failures remain actionable; corrected credentials recover.
Saving and reconnecting preserve the selected route and credential-vault behavior.
prerequisites: A disposable Navidrome account and the registered desktop client.

expected: The raw escaped apiKey is sent without password/user/Basic authentication; only the mode persists in configuration.
The production route and session reject another account's key and preserve external cancellation.

steps: Select API Key in Settings on an API-key-enabled server and sign in.
Try a key belonging to another username.
Switch the secret or authentication mode during an outstanding connection.
expected: Only the key owner reaches the library.
The key remains in the credential vault, and errors permit correction.
Late responses cannot connect or start a stream after the identity changes.
prerequisites: A server implementing API-key authentication, two disposable key owners, and native Settings access.

expected: The exact repeated XML extension/version shape and server metadata are parsed; unadvertised versions are unsupported.
The real fixture reports its version, advertised extensions and current account.

steps: Open Account and inspect the server version and extension list.
Reconnect after changing an available server capability.
Make the extension request fail while library access remains valid.
expected: Capabilities and their versions match returned server data.
Unavailable extensions use documented fallback or an explicit error.
Capability errors remain visible without fabricating support.
prerequisites: A disposable Navidrome account and the registered desktop client.

expected: The production session restores a selected accessible library after reconnect and clears it on identity changes.
Actual returned library IDs reach browsing and genre queries.

steps: Choose each accessible music folder, including All Libraries.
Browse albums, artists, genres and search results.
Reconnect, restart the app, and change to an account with different access.
expected: Every query uses the selected server library ID.
A still-accessible selection survives reconnect/restart.
A removed or different-account selection cannot leak into the new library.
prerequisites: A server with at least two distinguishable music libraries and two disposable accounts.

expected: All album-list types encode their server parameters, offset, size and library; excessive pages are rejected.
All fixture albums can be traversed in smaller pages; year and genre filters match tagged metadata.

steps: Browse alphabetical-name/artist, newest, recent, frequent, random, starred, rating, year and genre lists.
Traverse a library beyond its first page and use Play All.
Change year direction, genre and library.
expected: Sort/filter behavior matches Navidrome and no remaining page is silently truncated.
Play All resolves the complete context and selected occurrence.
Invalid filters have clear validation and changes reset the page offset.
prerequisites: A disposable Navidrome account and the registered desktop client.

expected: Returned artist indices flatten to complete artist models.
The real fixture returns both artists and resolves albums through actual artist IDs.

steps: Open Artists, select an artist, then one of its albums.
Return to the artist and browse another library.
expected: All returned artists and album entries are reachable.
Navigation preserves server IDs and the selected library.
prerequisites: A disposable Navidrome account and the registered desktop client.

expected: Artist, album and song counts/offsets are independent; empty sync queries are preserved.
A real 125-song library crosses the 100-song page boundary without repeated IDs.

steps: Search for artist, album and song results, including Unicode and punctuation.
Continue every result category beyond the first page.
Clear/change the query and play a selected song or the complete results.
expected: Each category retains its own offset and context.
No stale query result or silent page limit replaces current results.
Empty, failed and successful queries remain distinguishable.
prerequisites: A disposable Navidrome account and the registered desktop client.

expected: Tagged genre counts and all 75 Jazz songs use the selected actual library.

steps: Open every returned genre and traverse its songs.
Change the library, return to Genres, and play a selected occurrence.
expected: Genre names/counts come from Navidrome.
Song pages and the playback context retain the selected genre/library.
prerequisites: A disposable Navidrome account and the registered desktop client.

expected: Track/disc/year, quality, multiple credits and enhanced tag metadata deserialize with explicit missing values.
Actual metadata and all 25 album tracks round-trip from the fixture.

steps: Open a song and its album/artist links.
Inspect track/disc/year, duration, bitrate, size, sample rate and available credits/tags.
Open an item with absent optional metadata.
expected: Displayed values and links match returned metadata.
Album track order is complete.
Missing optional metadata is omitted or clearly empty.
prerequisites: A disposable Navidrome account and the registered desktop client.

expected: Opaque artwork IDs and requested image size are encoded.
A generated fixture album exposes a cover ID and its endpoint returns actual image content.

steps: Inspect covers in album/song lists, details, player and completed downloads.
Test missing artwork and a server/network image failure.
Switch account while an image request is outstanding.
expected: The native image control decodes actual returned artwork in each context.
Missing/failing artwork preserves a usable page.
Old-account images do not replace the new context.
prerequisites: A disposable Navidrome account and the registered desktop client.

expected: The avatar URL retains the encoded current username and selected authentication mechanism.
The actual server returns a PNG placeholder when Gravatar is disabled.

steps: Open Account with Gravatar enabled and disabled.
Invalidate credentials or change the account while the image loads.
expected: The server avatar or placeholder renders with an accessible name.
Disconnected/changed accounts clear the old source.
A missing image does not block account operations.
prerequisites: A disposable Navidrome account and the registered desktop client.

expected: Each entity uses the correct star parameter and failed writes do not confirm success.
All three entity types can be starred, listed and unstarred on the real server.

steps: Star and unstar a song, album and artist from details/player.
Inspect each category in Favorites and reconnect.
Make one write fail.
expected: Confirmed changes and returned lists agree across views.
Failure leaves an actionable error and does not invent a successful favorite.
prerequisites: A disposable Navidrome account and the registered desktop client.

expected: Values above five are rejected and zero clears a rating.
Song, album and artist ratings, including clearing to zero, round-trip.

steps: Set and clear ratings for each supported entity from the native controls.
Refresh details and rating-sorted albums; make a write fail.
expected: Only 0–5 reach the protocol.
Ratings update after confirmed success and failures recover.
prerequisites: A disposable Navidrome account and the registered desktop client.

expected: Returned biography, notes and valid linked similar artists retain their data.
Absent provider metadata remains a successful empty response.

steps: Open artist/album information with supplied biography/notes, then with no provider data.
Follow a valid related artist and safe external information link.
expected: Text and related IDs match the server; unsafe links/markup cannot become executable content.
Absence and failures remain distinguishable.
prerequisites: Fixtures with populated provider metadata and absent metadata, plus native detail interaction.

expected: Artist names/optional IDs, recommendation counts, ordered song IDs and metadata survive requests/responses.

steps: Open an artist's top songs and a song's related music.
Play a selected result in context; exercise empty and provider-failure responses.
expected: Positive recommendations and their order come from Navidrome.
Empty or failed providers do not invent results.
The selected song and complete context reach the player.
prerequisites: A configured metadata/recommendation provider with known positive results.

expected: Size 1–500, optional genre/year bounds and real library IDs encode correctly; omitted filters stay absent.
The real fixture honors requested genre/size and both year bounds.

steps: Create mixes with 1 and 500 requested songs, a genre, year bounds and each library.
Use blank filters and invalid size/year input.
Play a selected result.
expected: Navidrome selects the returned songs using the stated filters.
Invalid input cannot start a disguised request.
The returned order/context reaches playback.
prerequisites: A disposable Navidrome account and the registered desktop client.

expected: Simulated native opening, start/pause/stop/seek ordering, position clamping, volume/mute/rate and queue context follow production control logic.

steps: Play native-supported WAV/MP3/AAC files; pause/resume, seek, skip and let a track end.
Adjust volume, mute and supported playback rates.
Buffer and fail a stream, then retry.
expected: Native MediaElement decodes actual audio and reports correct duration/state.
Transport, elapsed position and audible controls behave correctly.
Opening/failure/seek do not create a false listen or duplicate completion.
prerequisites: A disposable Navidrome account and the registered desktop client.

expected: Original/MP3/default format and bitrate preferences have the correct ordinary-stream parameters.
Queued songs use current preferences; only eligible unopened online songs retry once as MP3, retaining both failures.

steps: Save Automatic, Original and MP3/bitrate preferences and start already-queued songs.
Open an incompatible original and a failed compatible retry.
Test radio/local/already-playing failures.
expected: Current persisted preferences affect each newly started song.
Only eligible failures use the bounded MP3 fallback.
Both errors remain visible and original/offline/radio choices preserve their meaning.
prerequisites: A disposable Navidrome account and the registered desktop client.

expected: JSON profiles, normalized PCM limits, bps units, decision details and escaped token/offset parameters follow the source contract.
Advertised support negotiates the same server; absent/explicit preferences fall back correctly, while cancellation, denial and identity changes suppress stale sources.
A real direct WAV token returns byte-identical media and a 64 kbps decision returns actual MP3 media.

steps: Use Automatic with native and incompatible source codecs on a configured server.
Change bitrate, pause/resume during negotiation and skip/stop before completion.
Expire a token and deny a decision.
expected: Native playback decodes the chosen original/compatible stream and displays its actual mode.
Outstanding requests cannot replace the selected account/occurrence or lose the paused resume position.
Signed tokens stay transient and real denials remain errors.
prerequisites: A server advertising transcoding with FFmpeg, native/incompatible media and a controlled denial/expiry path.

expected: ReplayGain values retain explicit zero and missing metadata.
Persisted modes/preamp use the source gain/peak formula independently of user volume; invalid values and native volume limits are handled explicitly.

steps: Use tracks with known Track/Album gain and peaks; select Off/Track/Album and adjust preamp.
Test absent tags and a gain above native volume capacity.
Restart and test an offline copy.
expected: Actual output/control gain agrees with the source calculation.
User volume is preserved and unsupported amplification is reported.
Mode/preamp and metadata survive restart/offline playback.
prerequisites: A disposable Navidrome account and the registered desktop client.

expected: Selected occurrences, replace/append/play-next, removal/reordering/clear, shuffle cycles, previous history and Off/All/One preserve production queue semantics.

steps: Replace/append/play-next a complete context, including duplicate songs.
Select/reorder/remove current and noncurrent occurrences; clear the queue.
Exercise shuffle/previous and every repeat mode with natural endings and manual skips.
expected: The exact selected occurrence and current transition are preserved.
Shuffle/repeat/history remain correct across mutations.
Native commands are reachable by keyboard and touch.
prerequisites: A disposable Navidrome account and the registered desktop client.

expected: Queue entry order, duplicate indices and millisecond positions follow negotiated index-based/legacy contracts.
The real fixture restores all three entries, the duplicate occurrence index and 3456 ms position.

steps: Save a duplicate-containing queue at a nonzero position and restore it after restart.
Repeat with the index extension disabled and an empty queue.
Change account while restoration is pending.
expected: The native player resumes the returned occurrence and bounded millisecond position.
Legacy ambiguity is handled explicitly.
No foreign-account or late queue replaces the current selection.
prerequisites: A disposable Navidrome account and the registered desktop client.

expected: Presence/submission units, states, actual playing intervals and persisted occurrence records follow the source contract.
Pending account-scoped real listens persist and synchronize after reconnect without local duplicate occurrences.
Presence/seek-to-end does not increment real play counts; a qualifying submission increments once.

steps: Open/fail/seek/pause/resume tracks and complete qualifying playback.
Listen offline, restart, reconnect and retry pending reports.
Change account with pending reports.
expected: Only actual qualifying playback updates history/server play counts.
Pending timestamps and occurrence/account identity survive restart.
The standard API's lost-response/idempotency limit is not concealed.
prerequisites: A disposable Navidrome account and the registered desktop client.

expected: Now-playing entries retain full song metadata, player/state/position/rate.
The actual fixture reports the current song/account/playing state/position/rate.

steps: Open listening activity while another disposable client plays.
Leave the page open without selection, then select an item and deactivate the page.
Play a returned entry in context.
expected: Displayed metadata and activity match the server.
Refresh preserves selection and stops on deactivation.
Activity entries reach playback with actual song IDs.
prerequisites: A disposable Navidrome account and the registered desktop client.

expected: Variants, language, synced/untimed lines, ordering and extreme/duplicate offsets follow actual lyric metadata.
Actual tagged/sidecar fixture lyrics are retrieved and time-select correctly.

steps: Select lyric variants/languages during real playback and seek across timestamp boundaries.
Toggle follow, scroll manually, and use an offline copy.
Skip/change account while lyrics load; test empty and legacy responses.
expected: Highlight and scrolling follow actual media milliseconds and offsets.
Late lyrics cannot replace a different song/account.
Empty/unsupported/error states and cached variants remain useful.
prerequisites: A disposable Navidrome account and the registered desktop client.

expected: Playlist metadata/duplicates/readonly and repeated edit parameters preserve ownership and optional field semantics.
Create/read/rename/comment/public/add/remove/reorder/delete round-trip while metadata and duplicate order survive.

steps: Create a playlist from selected/queued songs with duplicates; reopen and play it.
Edit name/comment/public state, add/remove/reorder entries, then delete.
Use another owner's and a smart/readonly playlist; fail one mutation.
expected: All confirmed operations match server metadata and occurrence order.
Ownership gates metadata edits; readonly independently gates song edits.
Failed writes preserve recoverable state.
prerequisites: Owned, foreign-owned, public and smart/readonly disposable playlists.

expected: Catalog schema/account/file validation and HTTP/MIME/body/short-read/cancellation checks reject partial or fake media.
Production storage/event adapters cover completion, original retention, separate compatible copies, cancellation/retry, corrupt/missing files, offline access and account isolation.
Actual original WAV bytes are copied completely without replacing original export data.

steps: Download originals with metadata/artwork/lyrics, cancel/retry, and export through the native picker.
Restart disconnected; browse/play completed local files and export originals.
Test incompatible originals, failed MP3 conversion, missing files, corrupt catalogs and another account.
expected: Only completed validated files are playable; progress/cancel/retry/delete work natively.
Offline operations require no server handshake.
Original export remains byte-identical and cross-account access is rejected.
prerequisites: A disposable Navidrome account and the registered desktop client.

expected: Bookmark and queue positions preserve millisecond units.
2345 ms/comments and deletion round-trip with actual song IDs.

steps: Save a nonzero native playback position with a comment, reopen Bookmarks and resume it.
Delete the bookmark and repeat after an account change.
expected: Resume applies the correct bounded position after media opens.
Comments/deletion and account isolation match server state.
prerequisites: A disposable Navidrome account and the registered desktop client.

expected: Returned URLs/expiration and the epoch sentinel retain server semantics.
Create/list/update/delete preserves real generated URLs, changed dates, omitted-update dates and default creation expiration.

steps: Create a share from actual media IDs with explicit/default expiration.
List/open/copy/edit/delete the link.
Disable sharing or remove the role and repeat.
expected: Links and dates come from Navidrome; omitted expiration never claims unlimited lifetime.
Disabled/denied operations stay explicit and recoverable.
prerequisites: Sharing-enabled and sharing-disabled server policies with disposable shared media.

expected: The real station endpoint completes and an empty library remains valid.

steps: Play a returned valid station, pause/stop and open its safe homepage.
Test empty stations, unsupported audio and a failed station URL.
expected: Actual station stream URLs reach native playback without song-transcode substitution.
Empty/error states remain actionable.
prerequisites: At least one controlled audible radio stream and a failed stream.

expected: Station mutations retain encoded full URLs, opaque IDs and optional homepage clearing.
A real administrator can create/edit/clear-homepage/delete and confirm the returned station.

steps: As administrator create/edit/delete a station and clear its homepage.
Use invalid URLs, cancel a form and change account/page during a delayed form.
Repeat as a nonadministrator.
expected: Only an actual administrator can mutate stations.
Successful writes are confirmed and cancellation/stale forms cannot apply.
prerequisites: A disposable Navidrome account and the registered desktop client.

expected: Scan state/time metadata and the source-defined start endpoint are preserved.
An actual administrator starts a scan and observes completion at the expected fixture count.

steps: Open Account during idle/active scanning and start a scan as administrator.
Leave the page, reconnect, and repeat as a nonadministrator.
expected: Actual scan count/status/time update while active.
Only the returned administrator role enables start, and polling stops on deactivation.
prerequisites: A disposable Navidrome account and the registered desktop client.

expected: Returned user roles retain denied and allowed values.
Reconnect restores actual roles and optional error states; changing credentials clears the negotiated account.
The real administrator/stream/download roles and username are reported.

steps: Open Account with distinct administrator/download/share/jukebox roles.
Reconnect after changing permissions and make the user-info request fail.
expected: Role labels and enabled commands match returned permissions.
Missing/failed user info does not grant privileged actions.
prerequisites: A disposable Navidrome account and the registered desktop client.

expected: All command names, indices, second offsets and 0–1 gain use the correct parameter contracts.
The production page preserves remote order/current-index guards, stale/cancelled operations and unapplied gain drafts.
A disabled jukebox reports no role and the source-defined HTTP 501; this does not verify enabled device audio.

steps: On an enabled server player inspect the remote queue/status, transport, seek and gain.
Replace/append/remove/clear/shuffle, including duplicates and another client's concurrent changes.
Test missing role/disabled configuration and cancelled confirmation.
expected: Actual audio comes from the server device and commands match remote state.
Indexed/destructive operations recheck order/current selection and keep honest race limits.
Role/disabled/stale/cancelled operations remain safe and explicit.
prerequisites: An enabled jukebox with a real server audio device, another client and a disabled configuration.

expected: Seed/count and ordered acoustic match entries retain source IDs/metadata; malformed entries fail.
An unconfigured provider returns the source-defined HTTP 404; this does not establish positive acoustic results.

steps: Request acoustic recommendations for actual songs on a configured provider.
Play a selected match, then remove the provider and repeat.
Skip/change account during a delayed response.
expected: Positive match order and media come from the provider.
Absent/failed/stale results do not invent recommendations.
prerequisites: A configured acoustic provider with known similar songs and a provider-absent configuration.

expected: Start/end/count encode independently and returned match songs retain their order.
An unconfigured path provider returns the source-defined HTTP 404; positive paths remain separate.

steps: Choose actual current-account start/destination songs and request a positive path.
Play the resulting path; test absent providers and account/page changes.
expected: The provider supplies the actual path songs/order.
Foreign/stale selections and absent providers cannot fabricate a playable path.
prerequisites: A configured acoustic provider with a known path and at least two actual current-account songs.

features.title: Native restart, state and background behavior

expected: Production queue/state validation and simulated source opening preserve account, occurrence and bounded positions.

steps: Restart/restore with a paused duplicate queue, lyrics-follow setting and nonzero position.
Exercise native suspend/resume, background playback and system media controls.
Restore corrupt or other-account state and change selection before media opens.
expected: Actual native lifecycle preserves the intended account/queue/position without duplicate listens.
Background/system controls work on the declared Windows 8.1 target.
Corrupt or stale state cannot cause an unintended seek or wrong-account playback.
prerequisites: A disposable Navidrome account and the registered desktop client.

features.title: Functional navigation, keyboard and narrow views

steps: Reach each function from Home, detail pages, player and Account; navigate back with keyboard/touch.
Exercise focus and accessible labels at wide, narrow and scaled native viewports.
Repeat with loading, empty, selected and failed states.
expected: Every required action is reachable without hidden or covered commands.
Focus and keyboard/touch operations complete the same functions.
Native reflow preserves readable controls and task completion; visual fidelity remains a separate design audit.
prerequisites: A disposable Navidrome account and the registered desktop client.

aliases.reason: Both expose Navidrome artist indices; the client uses its ID3 model.
The source builds virtual artist/album directories, covered by ID3 detail navigation.
The legacy list shape is an alternative to the complete ID3 album-list function.
The ID3 favorite list covers the same three annotation entity types.
The client uses the artist-ID3 information variant.
The client uses the ID3 song-recommendation variant.
The ID3 search exposes the same typed music search function.
GetUsers returns only the logged-in user in the locked source; it is not a user directory.

fixedCompatibility.reason: The locked handler always returns Valid:true and has no license-management music task.

externalAdministration: Native web user/library/transcoding/plugin administration does not use the standard music-client API. Existing generic video code cannot establish Navidrome video support.
